report.title: Coupon makes my total go UP
report.body:
tried the SAVE10 code from the newsletter. I had 2 things in my cart (coffee beans and a mug, total showed $20.00), typed SAVE10 in the coupon box and hit "Apply coupon". It says "Coupon SAVE10 applied." but the total is now $30.00?? It should be $10 off, so $10.

Seems fine if there's only 1 item in the cart. Chrome on mac.

app_label: Corner Shop, a small online coffee-gear store with a cart and coupon codes

preconditions: the cart is empty on a fresh install
the store sells coffee beans and a mug
a coupon code SAVE10 exists and gives $10 off
the cart with coffee beans and a mug totals $20.00
steps: Add the coffee beans to the cart
Add the mug to the cart
Type SAVE10 in the coupon box
plan.expected: after applying SAVE10 the page shows "Coupon SAVE10 applied." and the cart total shows $10.00
plan.reported_actual: The page shows "Coupon SAVE10 applied." but the total increases to $30.00 instead of decreasing to $10.00. With only 1 item in the cart it works fine.
missing: assumed: the products are named 'coffee beans' and 'mug' in the store catalog
assumed: the cart is reached by a cart link or page reachable from the start page
What are the exact prices of coffee beans and the mug individually?
Does the coupon box apply to the whole cart or per-item?
plan.summary: Applying SAVE10 with 2 items in cart raises total from $20.00 to $30.00 instead of lowering to $10.00

# Coupon makes my total go UP

## Reproduce the report
Open http://localhost:4100/.
Stay on localhost:4100 for the whole run and do not open any other website.
Do each step once, in order. If the app behaves unexpectedly, do not undo, retry, repair or work around it: the behavior itself is what is being checked. Check the result right after the last step.
Steps:
1. Add the coffee beans to the cart
2. Add the mug to the cart
3. Open the cart
4. Confirm the cart total shows $20.00
5. Type SAVE10 in the coupon box
6. Click "Apply coupon"
The reporter says the correct behavior is that after applying SAVE10 the page shows "Coupon SAVE10 applied." and the cart total shows $10.00. Verify that after applying SAVE10 the page shows "Coupon SAVE10 applied." and the cart total shows $10.00.

verdict.headline: Applying SAVE10 to the $20.00 coffee-beans-and-mug cart left the total unchanged and showed no confirmation message.
verdict.root_cause: The valid coupon action did not update the cart or tell the shopper that the coupon was applied.
verdict.suggested_fix: Check the SAVE10 coupon handling for a cart containing coffee beans and an enamel mug. It should show “Coupon SAVE10 applied.” and reduce the $20.00 total to $10.00 after Apply coupon.

fixes.rationale: applyCoupon set a negative discount (-10) when the cart had more than one item, and render computes total = subtotal - discount, so the coupon increased the total. Always applying a +10 discount fixes it.
